acceptance: Capture, serialization, transfer, decode and recognition are timed independently for 1k, 10k and 50k-node pages with p50/p95/p99/max; transport variants compared.

negative.fixture: number-array versus base64 transport at 100 KB, 1 MB, 4 MB

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
performance_memory_storage: p50 end-to-end 31 ms / 128 ms / 594 ms for 1k / 10k / 50k nodes; 50k capture 319 ms, pack 177 ms, transfer 44 ms; p99 equals max for n<100
known_limitations: Single 4 vCPU host, headless Chromium 141; absolute numbers are indicative, ratios are the finding
